hero.lead: AAYKAY designs, installs, tests and commissions electrical works for hospitals, enterprise campuses, data centres and high-rise towers, from shop drawing to handover.

company.sub: An ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified MEP contracting company, established in Hyderabad in 2008.
company.paragraphs:
AAYKAY Electricals Private Limited is one of the leading ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified MEP contracting firms, established in 2008.

With its focus on quality, safety, excellent service, a customer-centric approach, timely completion of projects and technical expertise in design, supply, erection, maintenance, testing and commissioning, AAYKAY has become one of the most preferred MEP contractors with top MNCs and Indian client partners since its inception in 2008.

AAYKAY has completed projects in a wide range of market segments: banks, hospitals, industries, data centres, IT parks, interior fit-outs, substations, and commercial and high-rise residential buildings.

Its site execution team of project managers, project engineers, safety and quality engineers, planning and coordination engineers, supervisors and electricians is supported by tender and marketing, procurement, design and billing engineers, and the accounts, finance, HR and administration team.

work_items.text: All-round electrical services: design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning.
Internal and external electrical works, as well as complete MEP packages.
Inspection of electrical systems and maintenance of electrical installations, including annual maintenance contracts.
Coordination with project management consultants, architects, quantity surveyors, design consultants and real estate service companies.

company.timeline_sub: From an electrical contractor in Hyderabad to a private limited MEP company with branches in {branches_word} states.

scope.title: HT/LT Panels & Distribution
scope.text: HT/LT panels, Capacitor Panels, MDBs, Distribution Boards along with accessories.

scope.title: Containment
scope.text: Conduit in slabs, walls and floors; sleeves and back boxes; GI cable trays, ladders, trunking and raceways.

scope.title: Wiring & cabling
scope.text: Power and lighting wiring, DB-to-equipment wiring, HT/LT cable laying, dressing, tagging, glanding and termination.

scope.title: Busducts & rising mains
scope.text: Busbar trunking and rising mains, supplied through OEM channels and installed to approved GA drawings.

scope.title: Lighting & accessories
scope.text: LED fixtures, lighting management systems, switches and sockets, fans and junction boxes.

scope.title: Critical power
scope.text: UPS and battery installation, server-room electrical works, AC unit connections, pumps and motors.

scope.title: Earthing & protection
scope.text: Earth pits and grids, GI and copper strip, surge protection devices and lightning arresters.

scope.title: Testing
scope.text: Megger, IR and continuity tests, panel load tests, circuit verification and HT/LT equipment testing.

scope.title: Fire Safety
scope.text: Fire alarm and detection systems, emergency lighting and power supply to fire-fighting equipment, installed and tested to approved drawings and local fire norms.

services.heading: Our Capabilities
services.lead: Complete electrical packages, from HT/LT panels, containment and cabling to lighting, earthing, critical power and fire safety: coordinated in Revit, installed to method statements and tested by our own commissioning team before handover.

pillars.title: Shop drawings & BIM
pillars.text: GFC review, shop and GA drawings, and MEP coordination in Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD.

pillars.title: Testing & commissioning
pillars.text: Our own team and test instruments for megger, IR, continuity, load and integrated system tests.

pillars.title: Site safety
pillars.text: Dedicated safety staff, HIRA risk assessments and an emergency response team on call 24/7.
